title: All poems about the same history in everything find the undefined and make it poetic haunted ruins dense, layered unknown get moved and make it poetic
summary: All poems about the same history in everything find the undefined and make it poetic haunted ruins dense, layered unknown get moved and make it poetic all you need, a body, a voice, an imagination feed the jazz of the poetic voice and drag out a physical response for if you live too much in your head no bodily poetry beyond missing cadence in hidden history
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
All poems
about the same
history in everything
find the undefined
   and
make
         it
             poetic
haunted ruins
dense, layered
unknown
get moved and make it
poetic
all you need,
a body, a voice, an imagination
feed the jazz of
the poetic voice and
drag out a physical response
for
if you live
too much
in your
                  head
no bodily
poetry beyond
missing cadence
in hidden history of
every moment
#smallpoems
#foolingwithwords
